name: 19263-decodeheavy-moonlight16b-1gpu
model: moonshotai/Moonlight-16B-A3B-Instruct -- bf16, ungated, ~30 GB of safetensors. It needs trust-remote-code on both the engine and the client tokenizer: the checkpoint ships its own config module and a TikToken tokenizer reached through `auto_map`.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1 -- no tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 320 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: prompts centred on 512 tokens (stdev 128, clamped 128-1024), generations pinned at 1024 tokens, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`, seed 42.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant generating 1024-token answers from brief prompts for 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at commit ac1f07487a6acdcf499d5edb6c8659aa809abba2 (gateway-v0.3.1-1535-gac1f07487a6).
model-path: moonshotai/Moonlight-16B-A3B-Instruct

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration module and a TikToken tokenizer reached through
# `auto_map`; guidellm is told the same through `spec.tokenizer.load_kwargs` in scenario.json.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1

# `fa3` is what this engine picks for itself for an MLA model on Hopper, so pinning it changes
# nothing here; it is written down so a future default or a different card cannot move the
# attention path out from under the item.
attention-backend: fa3

disable-radix-cache: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
